find_files.description: Find files by name pattern, extension, age and size (read-only)

dir_report.description: Folder summary: counts, total size, largest and newest files

system_info.description: CPU, RAM, disks, battery, uptime, OS

list_windows.description: Visible top-level windows with process names and titles

launch_app.description: Launch an app, file, folder or URL detached (never waits for it to close)

zip_files.description: Zip files into a new archive (never overwrites), verifies result

copy_files.description: Copy files to a folder (never overwrites; renames on conflict)

move_files.description: Move files to a folder with an undo manifest (never overwrites)

recycle.description: Send files/folders to the Recycle Bin with an undo manifest (never permanent delete)

extract_text.description: Extract text from PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT/MD/CSV into the task's ingested folder (chunked, labelled untrusted)

send_mail.description: SEND an email for real via the user's SMTP account (Gmail app password), with attachments. Not a draft.

web_text.description: Fetch a web page (allowlisted hosts only) and save readable text as untrusted data
